notes.title: Weekly update 14/07/2025
notes.notes:
[p]First of all, we skipped a patch last week, so apologies to the community.

Here is what we did:
-Introduced building upgrade mechanics to the grid. You can now spend resources to upgrade your mines and boost their production. To do this, left click to select a controlled resource building, without any hero selected and press the upgrade button around the building's portrait.
-Improved the sound manager and added many new sounds, including voice lines for enemy characters, building sounds, battlefield ambience and extra music tracks to loop through. We are still working to improve this further.
-Fixed a major bug where hero stats would get reset between different maps.
-Added functionality to display saved hero progress, such as level, experience, stats and equipped items to the hero recruitment screen.
-Many bug fixes to the inventory and equipped items systems, including receiving duplicate skills from equipping items, many fixes to item icons, descriptions and functionalities. We are still working on this and are trying to fix a major bug where some items disappear when being unequipped or overridden by another item.
-Fixed a bug where unit HP would not get updated visually on the battlefield. Working on fixing another visual bug, which causes killed characters to display the walking, instead of the death animation.
-Added tooltips for buffs and debuffs in the hero info screen.
-Added a local recruitment screen in the tavern for recruiting units outside your faction. Currently includes elven archers and dwarves will be arriving soon.
-Many other minor fixes and improvements.

We are now working to add garrisons to buildings on the grid, as well as functionality to repair damaged buildings. Thank you for your continued interest and support and stay tuned for more.[/p]

notes.title: Weekly Update 26/06/2025
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Friends,

Here is what we did this week.
We just deployed an update, addressing all of the game breaking bugs we currently know of, including:
-A new Stalemate functionality for the battlefield, to resolve endless combat scenarios, involving impassable terrain.
-Fixes to Imp Den buildings on the campaign, which could be attacked after being destroyed, leading to a case of endless combat.
-Fixes to the fog of war on the grid, which could break, after an NPC attacks you on their turn.
Additional improvements and fixes:
-Fixed a major bug, where AOE spells would not damage units in the targeted army and sometimes not apply debuffs. Working to further improve skills functionality.
-Fixed an issue, where hero progress saving functionality for the campaign would not extend to the full hero roster, but only the starting one.
-Capped Hero levels at 20 and we will soon fix the Steam achievements related to heroes.
-Added logic to prevent the use of certain skills over impassable terrain and we will continue to further improve on this functionality.
-Multiple improvements to the NPC AI, making them more aggressive on the grid and making less pointless movements on the battlefield. Also added some more skills to NPCs and will keep improving on this further.
-Multiple balance changes to the damage scaling of skills and debuffs.
-Multiple balance changes to the default action points of recruitable heroes.
-Added more voice lines for all existing heroes and working to further improve on the sound manager. 

Thank you for your interest in our game and feel free to drop by our discord to give feedback or chat with the devs.[/p]
